title: St Michael's Church, Songyae
geometryBasis: The named mapped roof envelope, approaching paths and the provincial dimensions establish the plan. The current mapped roof is wider and slightly longer than the 16 by 57 metre documented structure.
sectionBasis: The original front view establishes a tall dark timber shingle roof, ochre main gable, gold-carved lower gable, open porch, white gridded screens and a detached open bell tower to the left. Lengths, tier heights and trim depths beyond the documented building size are visual estimates.
limitations: The roof and 2006 porch describe the standing church. Rear elevations and side windows remain representative estimates.
The detached bell tower is placed approximately from the original view. Individual carved scrolls and leaded-glass motifs are simplified.
The modern grounds, school and interior are outside scope.
